title: Vergunningen, toezicht en handhaving
description: Six VTH case types (omgevingsvergunning bouwactiviteit, sloopmelding, toezichtzaak bouw, toezichtzaak milieu, handhavingszaak, invorderingszaak) with their statuses, roles, document types and fields, and four published flows. Handhavingszaak has two routes: regulier (the default) and spoedeisend. Installed on every install and upgrade; on an instance where the former VTH seeders ran, the existing rows are adopted.
